items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Gene Krupa and Lionel Hampton did bits on that show with us.

ctx.x: Of course, they're in all other things -- modern rock and pop and so forth now.

Milt, we're getting low on tape. However, before we run out of this side, I'll have to get to Louis Armstrong. Eventually, I got to know Louis Armstrong well, such as being on the performance and closing of the Storyville Show, we were on the Timex show in Miami. He did a couple of numbers with us, the Bob Crosby Band, when I was with the Bob Crosby Band on the same show, and actually, it was the Lawson-Haggard Jazz Band -- Crosby just fronted it. Gene Krupa and Lionel Hampton did bits on that show with us.
